description: This Java source file defines the GroupHelper class, providing utility methods for managing group entities in integration testing scenarios for the Fineract platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, activating, associating clients, verifying group details, and retrieving group-related accounts, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: GroupHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing group-related operations in integration tests for the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group with default or specified activation date, returning the group ID.

methods.name: createGroupWithError
methods.description: Attempts to create a group and returns server response attributes on error.

methods.name: associateClient
methods.description: Associates a client member to a group.

methods.name: disAssociateClient
methods.description: Disassociates a client member from a group.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates a specific group.

methods.name: updateGroup
methods.description: Updates a group's name.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified group.

methods.name: assignStaff
methods.description: Assigns staff to a group.

methods.name: assignStaffInheritStaffForClientAccounts
methods.description: Assigns staff with inheritance for client accounts inside a group.

methods.name: getTestGroupAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON representing a group for testing, with optional activation.

methods.name: associateClientAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to associate a client member to a group.

methods.name: activateGroupAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to activate a group with an optional activation date.

methods.name: updateGroupAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to update a group's name.

methods.name: assignStaffAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to assign a staff member.

methods.name: assignStaffAndInheritStaffForClientAccountsAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to assign a staff member with inheritance to client accounts.

methods.name: verifyGroupCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies the group exists on the server with expected ID.

methods.name: verifyGroupDetails
methods.description: Verifies specific details of a group match expectations.

methods.name: verifyGroupActivatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies whether a group is active on the server.

methods.name: verifyGroupMembers
methods.description: Checks if a group contains a specific client member.

methods.name: verifyOrphanGroupDetails
methods.description: Verifies details of orphan groups (groups with no parent).

methods.name: verifyEmptyGroupMembers
methods.description: Checks if a group has no client members.

methods.name: verifyGroupDeleted
methods.description: Confirms a group has been deleted.

methods.name: verifyRetrieveGlimAccountsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts associated with a group by group ID.

methods.name: verifyRetrieveGlimAccountsByGlimId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts by GLIM ID.

methods.name: verifyRetrieveGsimAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM accounts associated with a group.

methods.name: getChildAccountCount
methods.description: Returns the count of child accounts for a group.

methods.name: randomNameGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random unique name with a specified prefix and suffix length.

methods.name: getTestGroupWithDatatableAsJson
methods.description: Creates JSON for a group with datatable information for testing.

methods.name: getTestDatatableAsJson
methods.description: Generates JSON for a datatable associated with a group.
